newsitem.title: USA: Digital names Patton new president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Digital names Patton new president, CEO.

text.p: Digital Communications Technology Corp said Tuesday that Hugh Coppen will no longer be its president and chief executive, and that Cliff Patton will take over both positions.

The company said Patton, the former president and chief executive of American Quality Manufacturing Corp, has been employed as a consultant for the past four months and has been directing the relocation of its operations in Indianapolis into new quarters.

The company also said that it has retained Jim Weinberg, its co-founder, to serve in an advisory capacity to Patton and named him chief operating officer in charge of its Ft. Lauderdale, Florida, operation.

Additionally, the company said Chairman Kevin Halter has been given responsibility to oversee the entire operations of the company on a day-to-day basis until the board decides that such oversight is no longer necessary.
